## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed 85 captures during February 2021. Activity was delivered as planned across the reporting period, with session lists maintained for scheduled work. There were no reported disruptions to the overall service. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 85 captures, 2 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.4 per cent. The result indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review, with feedback provided where this may support improvement in future capture sessions.

## Grading

A total of 17 results were graded referable during February 2021. The median grading lag was 1 day. Grading activity therefore continued alongside capture activity, and the reported lag provides the monthly measure of turnaround. The referable results should proceed through the established follow-up arrangements. Overall, the site maintained planned activity, with a small number of ungradable captures and a median grading lag of 1 day.
